sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Shadow of Tagilla is a Scav Boss in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text: People fear Tagilla far beyond the walls of Polikhim Plant #16. Some managed to flee the Factory after hearing his roar. But no one has ever survived his sledgehammer. Veterans still remember how Tagilla toyed with the PMC squads who dared to explore The Labyrinth beneath the health resort.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Shadow of Tagilla does not set off tripwires.
- Shadow of Tagilla is immune to explosive damage.
- Shadow of Tagilla has different health values than PMCs and Scavs.
| Stats |
| Head: 105; Thorax: 360; Stomach: 280; Arms: 140 each; Legs: 140 each; Total: 1305 |
- Instead of the typical 4 single slot pockets, he has 3x (2x3 slot) and 2x (1x3 slot) pockets, bringing their total space to 24 slots.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Shadow of Tagilla needs to be killed for the quest Indisputable Authority.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: Shadow of Tagilla can be found in The Labyrinth. Due to the small size of the location he has to be expected everywhere.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text: He is batshit insane and will attempt to axe you down. However, if you are far away, he will use his secondary weapon to kill you from a distance.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: If you are using high penetrating ammunition, aim for his head, not his thorax. If you have low pen or high flesh damage, aim for his stomach since his armor only covers the thorax.
